description: 八字段 + 26 项 Zookeeper 月频 DSL 特征 / fold2 / 显式冻结的数据与算子。
limitations: Base is the previously authorized Kernel 1m-to-5m export, not native 5m.
Computational causality on a fixed final snapshot; full vendor vintage PIT not certified.
Test 2024-2025 has already been observed and is a historical diagnostic holdout.
Curve snapshot is incomplete: two documented auxiliary bars remain missing.
Integration is original 5m rows plus published monthly features. Raw far-contract 5m bars are not merged into the eight-field dataset.
The monthly formula DSL runs inside the data adapter. In a 5m method expression, zk_* is a published feature; rolling windows count 5m rows.
warmup_notes: 5m search windows retain one-year warmup; monthly DSL preparation uses all available source history and publishes only the exact previous calendar month.

notes: Daily windows reset on gaps in the observed union trading calendar. Curve returns also reset on actual leg changes.
Missing calendar months are explicit null rows; monthly rolling windows do not compress time.
Daily/monthly intermediate panels are not supervised targets and never enter method context as labels.
